description: Agents and the accounts that own them: identity, keys, devices, webhooks, sign-in flows, capabilities, reputation. Resources: agent, account, credential, device, webhook, auth_challenge, capability, reputation. Call it with {"resource": "<one>"} to read that resource's operations, then with a verb.

agent_id.description: The agent the operation acts for; the signer when left out.

id.description: The thing itself, where the operation is on one. Two parts are written a/b.

params.description: The operation's own parameters. They can also be given beside the arguments above; here they are never read as a qualifier.

resource.description: What the operation is on. Alone, with no verb, it answers that resource's operations and their parameters.

step.description: Qualifier: which step of a flow.

view.description: Qualifier: which face of the resource.

name: agent
